result.title: SimplePro: A Simple Baseline for Proactive Video Understanding
result.summary: Proactive video understanding requires vision-language models (VLMs) to decide not only what to answer as a video unfolds, but also when newly arrived evidence warrants a response and when to remain silent. Although modern VLMs excel at offline long-video understanding, they struggle in proactive streaming settings, leading prior work to introduce task-specific reinforcement learning or auxiliary triggering modules. We find that explicit reporting rules and structured streaming context substantially improve a frozen VLM's proactive response performance. We exploit this observation to build SIMPLEPRO, a training-free baseline for proactive video understanding. At each decision step, the model combines recent high-resolution frames, bounded historical observations, and prior answer records to determine whether new information warrants a response and, when needed, generate a concise answer. The system then filters consecutive duplicate answers while retaining the raw outputs as context for subsequent decisions. Without any parameter updates or auxiliary triggers, SIMPLEPRO with a 4B backbone consistently outperforms specialized proactive systems across OVO-Bench, StreamingBench-PO, and ProactiveVideoQA. SIMPLEPRO shows overall performance gains as backbone size increases from 2B to 32B. We hope this simple yet effective method will serve as a strong baseline for proactive video understanding, and we will release our code and inference pipeline to support future research.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练基线 SimplePro：每个决策步结合近期高分辨率帧、有界历史观测与既往答案记录，判断新证据是否值得回应并在需要时生成简洁答案，并过滤连续重复答案；在三个流式视频基准上以 4B 主干超过专用方法，且性能随主干规模提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 「新证据是否足以触发回答」的判定与有界历史加答案记录的上下文设计，可供核查 LVR 中 STOP 决策、证据筛选与状态维护的收益／成本，也提供了一个强免训练对照基线；但该工作只评测流式视频任务表现，未触及 latent 推理状态，机制层面联系需读原文。
